'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kinser LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kinser]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
